input.content: React 19 is now stable! This release includes Actions for handling async operations, the use() hook for reading resources, ref as a prop, improved hydration error reporting, and React Server Components are now stable.

Tailwind CSS v4.0 is a ground-up rewrite built on Oxide, a new high-performance engine. CSS-first configuration replaces tailwind.config.js. Container queries, 3D transforms, and wide-gamut colors built-in.
The Vite CommonJS Node API has been deprecated. Please migrate to ESM. The require() calls to Vite APIs will stop working in Vite 6.
